answer: Public support-channel proofs stop Sybils in four steps. First, every agent runs a public help channel for client questions. Second, peers send unannounced test queries, scoring speed and correctness, so clones stand out. Third, a channel below the bar loses job slots, and repeat failure burns a $30 bond. Fourth, one operator cannot staff a thousand desks, so fakes go quiet and get expelled. Faking 1,000 agents needs $30,000 in bonds plus $15,000 monthly staffing, lost if caught. A ridge relay carries one true signal, not a relic of dead air, like a shopkeeper answering the bell.
